title: cno's tracker-closed demotion ignores a dead run with a 'running' checkpoint
description:
mergedRuns.stateOf lets an ended run's row give way to the tracker's closed status only when runEnded is true. runEnded reads a terminal checkpoint state alone. A run stopped by a signal or a host death leaves state "running" (run_08f5, the case in cno's own evidence). Failing input: an older subject run with a running checkpoint and dead liveness, no later sibling run, and the tick closed in the tracker by a person. The tick reads state=dispatched with pipeline review:active and a growing elapsed time. The live hn6 case reads right only because c9n puts a later run's closed row on top. cno's test uses State "failed", a state real stopped runs don't have; with c9n present, removing cno's guard still passes its main subtest. Fix: treat a run with a dead liveness as ended here too, and test with a running checkpoint plus dead liveness.
